sentences.en: Every child needs someone to admire and emulate.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子都需要一个值得仰慕并追赶的对象。

sentences.en: Algeria should emulate what successful economies like Vietnam and South Korea achieved.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚应该效仿越南和韩国等成功经济体所取得的成就。

sentences.en: Sami was trying to emulate his father.
sentences.zh: 萨米试图效仿他的父亲。
